Rafael (Product): Heads-up: in the Project > Data policy panel we've had 3 customer tickets asking what \"Retention: 30 days\" actually means. They're unclear on policy vs. actual kept data after exports/ingestion rules. Screenshot attached (mock): https://redwood/mock/retention-ux Maya (Design): Oof. We should avoid single-number summaries. Proposal: two-line compact summary w/ tooltip: - Policy: 30 days - Effective: 23 days (route: logs-ingest) And a tiny help link that opens a modal with examples (exports, manual overrides, legal holds). Jun (Security): Strong +1. Also: current KMS label in the header just says \"KMS: BYOK\" which is terse. Suggest full label on first render: \"Customer-managed key (BYOK)\" then a short form 'BYOK' afterwards. Also we need to surface key status: active, rotated, compromised, disabled. Sam (Frontend): Implementation notes: - Add i18n keys: `settings.kms.label.full` and `settings.retention.summary.compact` - Use `aria-describedby` to link the policy/effective lines to the help tooltip for screen readers. Code example for screen reader hook: ```

Policy: 30 days

Effective: 23 days (route override)

What's this?
``` Maya (Design): Microcopy options to A/B test (short forms for the table): - Option A: \"Policy: 30 days · Effective: 23 days\" - Option B: \"30d policy · 23d effective (route: logs-ingest)\" - Option C: \"Policy: 30d — Effective 23d (overridden)\" Rafael (Product): Also flag for legal-hold behaviour: if a dataset is under legal hold, we should replace effective with \"Held: indefinite (legal hold)\" and highlight it with an orange badge and accessible text. Jun (Security): Audit log copy needs tightening. Current event text is inconsistent: e.g., `kms_update by bob` vs `KMS key rotated`. Recommend canonical forms: `kms.rotate`, `kms.disable`, `kms.delete` as machine codes + human message: \"KMS key rotated — user: bob@example.com (console)\". Include key fingerprint in metadata. Sam (Frontend): We can push the machine-readable event code into the DOM as `data-event-code` for telemetry and keep the human text visible. Sample: `data-event-code=\"kms.rotate\"` Maya (Design): Visual treatment: key status pill should include icon + text (lock, rotate icon), not color-only. For contrast, use navy-blue (#0A4FFF) for active and mid-gray for inactive. Also use a 1px border to increase visibility on light backgrounds. Rafael (Product): UX copy for the pill (single-line): \"Customer-managed key (BYOK) — Active\". For disabled state: \"Customer-managed key (BYOK) — Disabled; rotate or re-enable\". Keep one variant that shortens to \"BYOK — Active\" in compact views. Jun (Security): Add recommended audit entry template to docs (copy/pasteable): ``` { "event_code": "kms.rotate", "message": "KMS key rotated", "user": "alice@example.com", "method": "console", "key_fingerprint": "ab:cd:ef:01" } ``` Rafael (Product): Action items: Maya mock two compact variants, Sam to add aria-describedby and `data-event-code` hooks, Jun to update audit log examples in security docs, I'll own copy decisions and notify support. ops-bot: Reminder: design review slot booked for Wed 10:00am (calendar invite sent). Sam (Frontend): I'll open a tiny PR that wires `settings.kms.label.full` and the retention summary i18n keys; will include tests for aria attributes. ETA EOD tomorrow. Maya (Design): Dropping Figma frames for A/B options by EOD today. :sparkles: Jun (Security): I'll draft the audit schema PR and circulate with example SIEM mappings. Rafael (Product): Great — let's aim to ship the text and aria changes behind a feature flag so translations aren't blocked. Thanks team!
